study_kind: prospective authored maintenance pilot; no representative task-population claim
registration: publish this protocol, fresh tasks, context tool and generation runner at an exact Git commit before any formal model request; --run requires that exact commit and rechecks source/tool identity before each provider request
order: listed task order; complete-json first on even task index and focused-json first on odd index
fixture: Each task has 26 functions: target, one editable helper and 24 disclosed synthetic background functions; fixture size is fixed before any model run
interface_policy: existing hia.patch.v1/v2 with preserve policy; only the named helper body may change; expected_sha256 binds the complete original module
initial_payload: complete-json receives the whole source and complete opcode catalog; focused-json receives complete selected helper body, exact direct-call interfaces/call sites, function inventory and opcode slice from the public context tool
same_public_tools: context (including more bodies and extra opcodes)
final original-snapshot patch or previously accepted patch digest
final_check_budget: At most three check RPCs, plus one final patch's full public admission/execution if final supplies a patch instead of an already accepted digest; final is always terminal

pre_generation_cli_observation.observed_stderr: WARNING: proceeding, even though we could not create PATH aliases: Read-only file system (os error 30)
pre_generation_cli_observation.handling: This actual help/version warning is stderr and is retained as bounded raw stderr, not relabelled as a JSONL startup event. No stdout JSONL warnings have been observed; their registered whitelist remains empty. No model was invoked by these help/version probes.

hidden_policy: Fresh deterministic hidden cases and independent oracles never enter model prompts or feedback. One terminal hidden evaluation follows final public acceptance. Failed hidden checks cannot cause retry or prompt adjustment.
resource_policy: returned_view_byte requires actual VM allocation, matching owner/index/value store and read, release of that owner and zero live owners/loans on each selected case; static opcode presence is insufficient
execution_scope: bounded actual HIA VM execution and full-module verifier only; this pilot makes no native backend or Rust comparison claim
token_accounting: retain actual provider input/cached/cache-write/output/reasoning fields on every attempted request including failures. Descriptive token units = input + output + reasoning; cached input is a subset and is not added twice. Provider field overlap is not attested and these units are not billing. Missing usage is unknown and disqualifies efficiency claims; UTF-8 bytes are never converted into model tokens. Limits are checked after generation, not claimed hard provider-side caps.
wall_accounting: include initialization, all information requests, checks, failed repairs, generation and terminal hidden execution; charge common measured preparation once to each standalone arm; human work and provider-cache effects remain unknown unless independently measured
success_gate: All four fresh cells attempted with unchanged registered files and original responses; complete observed usage; every public and hidden value correct and resource witness satisfied. A descriptive focused-context advantage also needs no fewer successes, no more failed public checks, and both lower total observed token units and lower total end-to-end wall time. Two authored tasks cannot prove general model productivity.
no_repairs_or_selection: no hand editing model answers, reused historical answers, choosing a model after outcomes, excluding failed cells, or changing task size/public cases after formal requests
preflight: collector checks an explicitly requested executable or PATH codex, without executing it or inspecting credentials. Executable presence is not provider connectivity or inference authentication. Missing provider executable is a recorded blocked environment; zero model requests is not successful model completion.
generation_transport: original CodexEvents/run_owned transport with explicit frozen limits; each response uses a fresh ephemeral read-only CLI process and complete public conversation. Direct CLI tools or unregistered events reject. Raw streams and every provider usage field are retained. Binary identity is recorded, but provider weights/cache/routing and inference authenticity are not independently attested.
